request: Provide the short local address http://127.0.0.1:8878/A0 as an A0 entry, retain the observed 8878 minus-one mnemonic, and expose the Owner hierarchy 1.111.111.111 -> first 3x3 -> flap -> local subaddress with explicit technical boundaries.

route.behavior: The static server normalizes /A0 to /A0/. The entry preserves an explicit query and hash; when no hash is present it selects #body-exhibition and replaces browser history.

reading.technical: 127.0.0.1 is the IPv4 loopback address. 8878 is the selected local preview TCP port and carries no NEXAH or protocol semantics.
reading.interface_mnemonic: 8·8·7·8 can be read visually as a single minus-one displacement, 8→7, moving inside a field of 8s. The visible Address Aperture reads // as the paired directed channel rails, ≠ as their transversal crossing, ↗ as the 01:00 / 77-LINE orientation, and IN as Einzug / Return.
reading.claim_boundary: The mnemonic is a display and navigation reading only. It is not a mathematical identity, network rule, empirical finding, physical mechanism or scientific evidence. 1.111.111.111 is retained as an Owner address label, not asserted as a literal registered IPv4 address.

owner_hierarchy.semantics: The hierarchy is a navigational projection. The 3x3 carrier, shared flap hinge and local route remain distinct existing objects; no identity collapse or duplicate engine is introduced.

open_boundary: The short address works only while a local HTTP server serves the package root on port 8878. This change does not create, configure or publish an external deployment.
